purpose: Native-architecture and saturation closeout for the independent 54.38-Gb delta universe
structural_input_rule: include every DELTA32 candidate whose frozen reference-set structural compatibility tier is STRONG or SUGGESTIVE

partner_rules.recurrent_partner_definition: same partner cluster in >=2 independent source accessions within the same structural-positive RT family

primary_native_architecture_endpoints: family with any exact repeat array
family with strict published ART geometry
family with strict geometry plus recurrent nearest-downstream partner cluster
saturation_endpoints: native architecture recovery among the frozen 12 delta structural-compatible families
architecture distribution across source strata A/B/C/D
claim_boundaries: 12/32 is a conditional frozen priority-panel generalization rate, not a per-Gb yield
delta-only family exclusion intentionally makes the 54-Gb priority panel harder and more out-of-distribution
strict ART geometry is a descriptive architecture label and does not establish biochemical RT activity or ART identity
nearest downstream ORF remains a partner candidate until causal validation
no post-result retuning of structural, repeat, partner, or source-selection rules is authorized

changes: close zstd stdout before process wait on early FASTA-record completion to prevent pipe deadlock
group requested contigs by source file and scan each compressed source FASTA at most once
